# opnsense_haproxy_group (Resource)

HAProxy user lists (**Services ▸ HAProxy ▸ Settings ▸ Advanced ▸ User Lists**, plugin `os-haproxy`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name to identify this group.

### Optional

- `add_userlist` (Boolean) Usually HAproxy userlists are created automatically in a context sensitive way. This option adds this group as userlist, so that it can be referenced in rules/conditions. All special and non-alphanumeric characters will be removed from the userlist name. Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) Description for this group. Defaults to ``.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this group. Defaults to `true`.
- `members` (Set of String) Members. Defaults to `[]`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the user list.
